title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Auburn University
description: Navigate Auburn after dark with these under-21-safe late-night destinations, from 24-hour campus markets and study halls to iconic off-campus diners and safe transit options.

cards.title: 24/7 Campus Provisions
cards.subtitle: Central Dining Commons
cards.notes: Access snacks, beverages, and microwaveable meals 24/7 using your Tiger Card at this automated market located near the ACLC.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 automated campus market providing essential snacks and meals for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Students may access and purchase food 24/7 at the Central Market located in the Central Dining Commons.
cards.source_title: Central Market - Auburn University Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with valid university identification.

cards.title: Safe Campus Transit
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Service
cards.notes: Request a safe ride between any two on-campus locations from 6 p.m. to 7 a.m. daily through the Auburn Safety app.
cards.short_summary: A university-operated shuttle service ensuring safe point-to-point travel across campus throughout the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Night Security Shuttle operates between 6 p.m. and 7 a.m. and transports passengers to on-campus locations only.
cards.source_title: Night Security Shuttle Service | Campus Safety and Security
cards.access_notes: Available 6 p.m. to 7 a.m. daily for students and staff.

cards.title: The Midnight Study Hub
cards.subtitle: 231 Mell Street
cards.notes: Utilize extensive study spaces and collaborative zones; check the library website for current late-night and 24-hour finals schedules.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering late-night study environments and resources for Auburn students.
cards.evidence_claim: Auburn University Libraries provide updated fall hours and study spots for the semester ahead.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open until midnight or later during peak academic periods.

cards.title: Late-Night Tray Tradition
cards.subtitle: 333 S College St
cards.notes: Visit this popular drive-thru for signature trays and over 40 milkshake flavors, open until 3 a.m. or later.
cards.short_summary: A staple late-night fast-food destination known for its diverse menu and extended early-morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically close at 3:00 AM on weekdays and 4:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cookout Hours 2026: Open, Close & Holiday Times
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 a.m. Sun-Thu and 4 a.m. Fri-Sat.

cards.title: 24-Hour Diner Classic
cards.subtitle: 2167 S College St
cards.notes: Enjoy classic diner fare any time of night at this 24-hour location situated south of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour diner serving breakfast and comfort food to students at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House at 2167 S College St is open 24 hours daily for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: Late-Night Pizza Slices
cards.subtitle: 129 E Magnolia Ave
cards.notes: Grab a slice or a whole pie at this downtown favorite, open until 2 a.m. on weekdays and 3 a.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A popular downtown pizzeria offering late-night service and Italian-style comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy Auburn is open Monday-Thursday until 2:00am and Friday-Saturday until 3:00am.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 a.m. Mon-Thu and 3 a.m. Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Always-Open Burger Run
cards.subtitle: 101 N College St
cards.notes: Located steps from Toomer's Corner, this 24-hour spot is a go-to for burgers and late-night breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food chain located in the heart of downtown Auburn near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger at 101 N College St offers 24-hour service and delivery in Auburn.
cards.source_title: Whataburger Auburn, AL | Burgers, Fast Food, Shakes

cards.title: 24/7 Engineering Lab
cards.subtitle: Broun Hall, Room 123
cards.notes: Engineering students can access this computer lab 24/7 for late-night projects and technical work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour computer lab for engineering students located in Broun Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Engineering computer labs, including Broun 123, are open 24 hours, 7 days a week while classes are in session.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for engineering students; closed during home football weekends from Friday midnight to Sunday noon.

cards.title: Late-Night Slider Stop
cards.subtitle: 1927 S College St
cards.notes: Famous for its square burgers, this 24-hour location provides a quick late-night meal option south of campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour quick-service restaurant known for its signature sliders and late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Krystal at 1927 S. College Street in Auburn is open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The Late-Night Living Room
cards.subtitle: 255 Heisman Drive
cards.notes: Gather for late-night study or socializing until 11 p.m. daily in the heart of campus.
cards.short_summary: A central campus hub offering study areas and resources until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harold D. Melton Student Center is open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Harold D. Melton Student Center - Auburn University Student Affairs
